kurz: Too much chilli cannot be cooked out, but it can be softened: with dairy, fat, acid and more bulk.
bild_im_kopf: Like an instrument that is too loud in an orchestra: you cannot make it quieter, but you can make the others louder.

ursachen.titel: Too much chilli, or chillies with their membranes
ursachen.warum: [[capsaicin|Capsaicin]] does not dissolve in water, so diluting with water barely helps.
fix: Stir in yoghurt, cream, coconut milk or milk
Add more of the other ingredients
A little sugar and acid balance it out

ursachen.titel: Chilli steeped in oil too long
ursachen.warum: A lot of capsaicin dissolves in fat.
fix: Fry chilli more briefly or add it later

q1.frage: Did you fry the chilli in oil for a long time at the start?
